title: RelaySchema
description: ANet Relay API v1 models (backend/tools/export_schema.py; do not edit).

payload_kg.description: payload, kg; take-off weight is mass_kg + payload_kg

prop_damage.description: damage of one propeller 0..1 (thrust loss, vibration)

imu_noise.description: attitude, rate and acceleration noise multiplier

arm_bias_deg.description: random level error of up to this many degrees per axis, new at every arming

with_assist.description: the defects act with hover assist on as well (altitude hold keeps the height)

AirframeRef.description: The snapshot's view of a simulator airframe: preset and seed only, never the values (06 §4).
AirframeRef.title: AirframeRef

ArenaMatch.description: WP-B (07 §4): the current or the last match; times on the backend wall clock.
ArenaMatch.title: ArenaMatch

id.description: the peer's install id, 16 hex digits

ArenaShot.description: A bullet in flight: integrate from (p, v) at t0 with the shared 1/240 s integrator.

t0.description: backend wall clock at which p and v hold (same clock as Fleet.t)

ArenaShot.title: ArenaShot

ArenaVehicle.description: A remote simulator, converted into this terminal's local frame (ENU m, radians).

yaw.description: rad, compass heading in the local frame

ArenaVehicle.title: ArenaVehicle

yaw.description: rad, NED heading: 0 north, clockwise positive

sha256.description: digest of the pack's tarball, when the index lists it

usable.description: the pack can run on this computer

twins.description: firmware twins running on this pack (GET /autopilots)

AutopilotPacks.description: ``GET /autopilots``: the packs of this platform, bundled first.
AutopilotPacks.title: AutopilotPacks

origin.description: [x, y, z, heading_deg] of the course origin

rings.description: rings placed in the vehicle's position frame

state.description: booting | arming | deploying | flying | human | down | stopped | failed

lan.description: on the LAN (the match is shared) or local practice

phase.description: idle | booting | arming | deploying | running | ending | done

by.description: operator, or the session that started it

reason.description: why it ended: time | stopped | error

board_id.description: ArduPilot bootloader board id, PX4 USB product id

FirmwareInfo.description:
The aircraft's firmware identity (11 §4) from HEARTBEAT and AUTOPILOT_VERSION; null fields are
not reported by the aircraft (or not decoded yet).

vehicle.description: copter / plane / rover / ... from HEARTBEAT type

git.description: first 8 hex digits of the firmware's git hash

board.description: flight controller board name for common boards, e.g. Pixracer

FirmwareInfo.title: FirmwareInfo

recommended.description: pack id; null when no pack of this firmware is installed

warning.description: series and below: the control loop may differ from the aircraft's

candidates.description: every usable pack of the same firmware, best first

FlightHealthView.description: Rolling diagnostics over the last few seconds (03 §5.9). Flight items need the aircraft airborne.
FlightHealthView.title: FlightHealthView

expected.description: backup value; null: not in the backup

actual.description: value after the restore; null: not reported

x.description: m east of the board's local origin (physics truth)

q.description: FRD to NED quaternion w, x, y, z

sensor_hz.description: HIL_SENSOR frames sent in the last second (250 when healthy)

gps_hz.description: HIL_GPS frames sent in the last second (10)

since.description: wall clock of the start, UTC epoch seconds

cause.description: sim | unidentified | ardupilot | other_firmware | not_serial | busy | pending | link | armed | possession

pending_restore.description: a restore is owed from an earlier session

LeaderboardRow.description: One aircraft. The statistics are null for a 0.4 peer (no statistics block).

key.description: sim-N here, <peer id>/sim-N for a peer's aircraft

alive_s.description: current survival time (at the time of the reply)

LeaderboardRow.title: LeaderboardRow

index.description: step being flown (equals count once done)

tuning.description: throttle tuning of the stick steps: climb, hover (PlanTuning)

ProcedureBrief.description: The aircraft's bench procedure run, current or last (WP-B, 05 §4.4).

step.description: step id while the run is active

ProcedureBrief.title: ProcedureBrief

id.description: props_removed, motor_check, calibrate_gyro, arm_start, apply_param, paused, ...

confirm_word.description: word the answer must carry on this aircraft, if any

operator_only.description: only the operator (the Relay window) may answer

data.description: motor layout, motor, sensor, item to apply, blocking checks

ProgramRunView.description: The program deployed on an aircraft, running or last run (WP-1, 06 §2.6).

reason.description: why it is paused, stopped or faulted (a code)

fps.description: frames run in the last second (50 when healthy)

overruns.description: frames over the 2 ms soft budget

rates_ok.description: ATTITUDE reached 40 Hz after the rate request; null: not yet

log_seq.description: sequence of the newest log line (GET .../program/log?after=)

ProgramRunView.title: ProgramRunView

ProgramStateMachine.description: A program's ``StateMachine`` as the inspector shows it (WP-1, 06 §2.3).
ProgramStateMachine.title: ProgramStateMachine

c.description: centre [x east, y north, z up], m

yaw_deg.description: compass heading of the ring normal

SerialLinkView.description: The snapshot's ``vehicle.serial``: the port of a serial aircraft (null on UDP and simulators).

device.description: current device name (a USB board that reappears renamed is followed)

open.description: false while the device is away; Relay reopens it once a second

reopened.description: times the port was reopened after an error

SerialLinkView.title: SerialLinkView

device.description: path or name to connect with: /dev/ttyACM0, COM5, /dev/cu.usbmodem01

serial_number.description: USB serial number (PX4 boards report their unique id)

autopilot.description: a known flight controller USB interface

kind.description: usb-serial: a plain adapter (CP210x, FTDI, CH340), e.g. a telemetry radio

adapter.description: CP210x, FTDI or CH340 for usb-serial

vehicle.description: the aircraft connected on this port

available.description: false: pyserial is missing, serial links cannot be used

SimAirframe.description: GET / PUT /sims/{vid}/airframe: the full values (operator or controller).

active.description: the defects act now (hover assist off, or with_assist)

level_now_deg.description: [roll, pitch] level error of this flight: calibration error plus the arming bias, deg

hover_throttle.description: level hover throttle 0..1 out of ground effect at full battery; null: cannot lift

SimAirframe.title: SimAirframe

SimFirmware.description: A firmware twin's firmware (11 §10): runtime pack, match level against its profile, process state.

match.description: against the profile's firmware; null without a profile

state.description: running: the firmware flies; restarting after a reset; exited

SimFirmware.title: SimFirmware

thrust_to_weight.description: derived from the hover thrust parameter on a twin

SimView.description: Simulator flight model (05 §5.2, WP-C); null on real aircraft.

hover_assist.description: altitude and position hold available; false: physical flight

turbulence.description: turbulence strength 0..1 (acts only with hover assist off)

SimView.title: SimView

id.description: increments with every skill started on this backend

progress_s.description: sequence: seconds into the time line

duration_s.description: sequence: length of the time line

phase.description: sequence: mode | arm | play | end | hold

frames.description: one row per t, in the order of fields

lines.description: the last 40 lines of the firmware's output

thrust_to_weight.description: derived from the hover thrust parameter on a twin

stalls.description: steps the firmware did not answer within the tick's wait

frames.description: firmware frames (ArduPilot JSON frames, PX4 HIL exchanges)

ms_per_step.description: wall time per world step, ms

excluded.description: profile parameters it leaves out, with the reason

forced.description: values Relay sets for the lockstep (SIM_RATE_HZ)

TwinProfile.description: ``GET /twins/profiles/{id}`` (also the export): every parameter and the ones a twin leaves out.

pack.description: the runtime pack the twin starts

TwinProfile.title: TwinProfile

pack.description: the runtime pack the twin starts

UiCommandMessage.description: Server -> window over the operator WebSocket.
UiCommandMessage.title: UiCommandMessage

UiState.description: What the Relay window currently shows (04 §3.1).
UiState.title: UiState

programs_allowed.description: real aircraft: the operator allowed programs (reset when the link drops)

transport.description: udp: Wi-Fi bridge; serial: USB / UART port; sim: simulator

frame_problem.description: why a twin cannot fly this frame; null for quad X

VehicleHitl.description:
The snapshot's ``vehicle.hitl``: null without a session. While ``running`` the vehicle's position,
attitude and rates are the physics the board is fed.
VehicleHitl.title: VehicleHitl
